zh-CN.title: 数字交锋成长进度
items: 活动大厅和房间展示当前等级，以及距离下一等级所需的成长分
投入与结算后刷新成长进度；数字允许重复，首位可为0
猜测结果仅展示完全正确的位数，不再显示A/B

en.title: Code Duel growth progress
items: The lobby and room show your current level and points needed for the next level
Progress refreshes after entry and settlement; repeated digits and leading zeros are allowed
Feedback shows only exact-position matches, without A/B notation
